justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/visitor/NodeFinderVisitor.java` and `javaparser-core-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/visitor/NodeFinderVisitorTest.java`. The class is 2208 LOC and defines 100 overridden `visit(...)` methods (103 public methods total), spanning declarations, expressions, statements, modules, types, and comments in one monolithic visitor, with shared mutable state (`selectedNode`) and a shared predicate (`fn`). This breadth and method count indicate a class that could be split into smaller, more cohesive abstractions.
